objective: ONE SHARED NHL STATE ENGINE + MULTIPLE INDEPENDENTLY VALIDATED OUTCOME HEADS. Not disconnected market classifiers: pregame information -> availability -> membership / expected participation -> role / deployment / TOI -> team shot environment -> individual shot / attempt process -> scoring / assist process -> goalie workload / save process -> team goal distributions -> game outcome distributions.
principles: Each head consumes shared upstream state where scientifically valid.
Sportsbook lines / odds / projections are NEVER predictive inputs; if sportsbooks disappear the engine still produces distributions.
Skill history may use legal all-team prior history; current role / deployment uses current-team prior history only; postgame target-game information never enters state.
No legacy result is promoted because it once passed; legacy models are comparators only.
No market is 'finished' until it has its own certified status; no rescue tuning after an exposed holdout; no feature borrowing because another market succeeded.

status_vocabulary.UNBUILT: nothing built under the new standard
status_vocabulary.LEGACY_FAILED: legacy artifact failed its own gate or stability test
status_vocabulary.LEGACY_STABLE_COMPARATOR: legacy artifact passed its old gate + old stability; comparator only, NOT a new-standard champion
status_vocabulary.RESEARCH: under research / feasibility, no certified model
status_vocabulary.COMPONENT_CANDIDATE: defined and quality-gated component of a candidate engine, not an independently certified head
status_vocabulary.HISTORICAL_CHAMPION: won its preregistered historical protocol (holdout exposed once)
status_vocabulary.FORWARD_SHADOW: collecting live forward evidence in shadow
status_vocabulary.FROZEN_REJECTED: preregistered branch failed; frozen, no rescue

player_identity.description: stable player_id; frozen skater-game table (Phase 1A, 9 seasons, quality-gated)

team_identity.description: team_id / abbreviation, home/away, from the frozen schedule

target_game_membership.description: Phase 0B candidate universe (last <=10 prior team games' skaters); coverage of actual participants and SOG reported per season; no historical PIT lineup / roster evidence
gaps: actual participants outside the candidate universe are unobservable at T
forward collector (Phase 0C) is measuring pregame rosterSpots recall

availability_participation.description: expected participation from prior team-game appearance history (PLAY_RATE_TG*, days since appearance); no injury / scratch knowledge, no PIT confirmation
gaps: B3 participation mixture was NOT promoted (Phase 1A)
historical PIT scratch/injury information not reconstructable

current_team_role_deployment.description: current-team prior-appearance TOI / PP allocation share / shifts (11 features) inside the frozen Phase 1A B2 feature set
gaps: PP allocation share is allocation, not true PP opportunity

toi_distribution_state.description: only recent-mean TOI features exist; no predictive TOI distribution / state model
gaps: TOI is a postgame quantity; its pregame distribution is unmodelled

goalie_candidate_start_state.description: who starts / appears; historical PIT confirmed starters are NOT reconstructable (Phase 0B), forward confirmation is being collected by the Phase 0C collector
gaps: starter fields on boxscore / right-rail are UNVALIDATED

schedule_venue_home_away.description: scheduled UTC start, IS_HOME, team rest hours, back-to-back from the schedule

skater_shots_on_goal.champion: Phase 1A B2 (Poisson mean + NB2 dispersion wrapper, alpha 0.001)

extension.name: Phase 1B-A lagged individual shot attempts
extension.result: ATTEMPT_SIGNAL_NOT_JUSTIFIED (S1 only: mean relative CRPS gain 0.339% < 0.5%; S2-S7 pass); source adjudication HYBRID_ATTEMPT_SOURCE_JUSTIFIED via PRE_SCORING_AMENDMENT_1 (literal protocol-1 rule: NOT_TRUSTWORTHY)

skater_shots_on_goal.reopen: only via the preregistered Phase 1B-A path

skater_points.note: legacy binary classifier: champion gate passed (AUC 0.6818, calib p 0.1514) but walk-forward stability FAILED (NHL_POINTS_WALKFORWARD_NOT_YET_STABLE, walk-forward calib p = 0.0271). New-standard head is UNBUILT; points should eventually be derived from the joint goals / assists process.

goalie_saves.note: legacy gate failed: AUC 0.5673, calibration p = 0.001, verdict NHL_GOALIE_SAVES_CHAMPION_DOES_NOT_CLEAR_GATE. New-standard head is UNBUILT (Phase G0 feasibility pending).

moneyline_win_probability.note: legacy binary XGBoost: champion gate passed (AUC 0.604, calib p 0.8193) and walk-forward stability passed (AUC 0.6115, calib p 0.9633). NOT a new-standard champion; the final architecture should derive win probability from team goal distributions.

team_shots.only_if: team shot environment state is certified

totals_derived_outputs.only_if: team goal distributions are certified (derived, not a separate classifier)

legacy_production_note: The currently deployed docs/nhl_predictions.json is produced by the LEGACY serving builder (moneyline, points, shots_on_goal, plus early-season variants; goalie_saves not served). Points and shots_on_goal are served by an explicit product decision despite failing their own calibration test. None of the new-engine heads is in PRODUCTION; no production serving was changed by this registry.

forward_collection.nhl_forward_collector: live on main (Phase 0C protocol 2); state on branch nhl-forward-state; status BLOCKER_INSUFFICIENT_LIVE_TIMING_EVIDENCE

governance: Every new predictive head after feasibility needs: protocol committed before performance, exact feature contract, exact development folds, temporal holdout rule, calibration + uncertainty metrics, slice guards, promotion gate, failure status, reopen conditions.
